description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class ReportAPI within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the REST API plugin. The class provides methods for handling report-related API endpoints, such as retrieving a report's header and filter definitions, and manages validation rules for input parameters. It enforces that certain operations like update, delete, and get validation rules are not implemented at this level and should be handled in subclasses.

classes.name: ReportAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing REST API endpoints for report management within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving report headers and filters with validation annotations.
